review_text: This branch gets pretty busy at night, especially since it's right beside Alorica and a lot of call center agents drop by after shifts. During the day, though, it's much quieter and more relaxed. Serving time is generally fast, but it can be a hit or miss depending on how packed the place is. At peak hours, expect some noise and a lively atmosphere, but overall it's still a convenient and decent spot for coffee, whether you're working, meeting friends, or just passing time.

This Starbucks branch offers a warm, dependable experience that feels both familiar and thoughtfully run. The space is clean, well-lit, and comfortable whether you are working, meeting friends, studying, or just killing time between errands. The baristas are polite, organized, and impressively efficient even during busy periods, and they manage the crowd with calm professionalism rather than stress or attitude. I especially appreciated how they prioritized my order in the queue when I mentioned that my Grab was arriving in less than five minutes; that small act of consideration genuinely saved me stress and showed real customer awareness. The drinks were consistently well made — smooth lattes, properly balanced iced beverages, and reliable flavor every time, with customization handled without hesitation. Another major plus is that the Davao Modern Bus now stops right in front of the location, making this branch extremely convenient for commuters who want a quick coffee or snack before heading home. What keeps this from a perfect score is the food selection, which I rated 4/5. While everything available tasted fresh and decent, the range felt limited; I wished for more pasta options, a wider variety of cakes, better pastries, and more creative sandwiches beyond the usual staples. Still, with great service, a pleasant atmosphere, and excellent accessibility, this Starbucks remains a solid and very practical go-to spot in Davao.

July 2023 — This is one of the busiest Starbucks branches in the city, and tonight was particularly chaotic. Both the ground and second floors were at full capacity, with tables and chairs packed so closely together that it was nearly impossible to hear yourself think. Most customers were practically shouting just to have a conversation which is definitely not the most ideal setting for a quiet coffee. However, on a regular day, this branch is usually a great place to hang out with friends. Just be prepared for the crowd if you're visiting during peak hours cause it can get very busy and crazy. Also, avoid seating near the glass wall from mid day to early afternoon cause the weather can get really hot.
